archetypes.name: dyn-closure-classifier
archetypes.rationale: Regex and section-state changes can over- or under-collect prompt references.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the skill-closure scanner changes for classifier precision. Focus on conditional reference matching, non-fatal path handling, and the shared section-depth state for design and implement macro sections. Check that runtime-only SECURITY.md prose stays untracked while audited runtime references become conditional. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
